description: WSO2 SAP S/4HANA Inspection Lot provides a way to interact with the [Inspection Lot API](https://api.sap.com/api/API_INSPECTIONLOT_SRV/overview). The service allows to read and update inspection lots with their operations, characteristics, subsets and serial numbers, record inspection results and sample results, and create usage decisions.
key-features: Read and update inspection lots, with their statuses, operations, characteristics and serial numbers
Record inspection results, single result values and sample results for inspection characteristics
Create usage decisions and post the related material document items
